open_findings.summary: Lstat FileInfo defers native identity lookup on Windows; replacing path before first SameFile fools created-file identity guard
steps: backupWriteSource creates item.txt and stores Lstat FileInfo
Rename original item.txt to item.txt.preserved without deleting it
Create a different native file at item.txt containing identical bytes
Second backupWriteSource returns nil despite distinct volume/file-index identity
open_findings.proof: replaced-native-id-proof.json records GetFileInformationByHandle original/replacement/preserved IDs; original remains same and replacement differs
open_findings.cause: Go1.27.1 os/types_windows.go loadFileId at287 resolves fs.path lazily; SameFile at353 first loads identity after replacement. Stored FileInfo has not frozen original native identity.
